entities.name: UAC-0006
entities.gloss: A financially motivated cybercriminal threat group operating since 2013 and targeting Ukrainian enterprises.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A country in Eastern Europe.

entities.name: SMOKELOADER
entities.gloss: A modular malware downloader used to drop and execute secondary malicious payloads on compromised systems.

entities.name: LOADERX3
entities.gloss: A specialized malware loader used by threat actors to execute additional payloads on compromised machines.

entities.name: RMS
entities.gloss: Remote Utilities (Remote Manipulator System) remote administration software frequently abused by threat actors for unauthorized access.

entities.name: RDPWRAPPER
entities.gloss: An open-source utility enabling concurrent Remote Desktop connections on Windows systems.

entities.name: DANABOT
entities.gloss: A modular banking Trojan and information stealer capable of credential theft and remote access.

entities.name: LUMMASTEALER
entities.gloss: An information stealing malware designed to extract credentials, cryptocurrency wallets, and browser data.

entities.name: REDLINESTEALER
entities.gloss: A commodity malware designed to extract sensitive data such as credentials, browser history, and crypto wallets.

entities.name: SYSTEMBC
entities.gloss: A proxy and remote access tool used by threat actors to tunnel malicious traffic and execute commands.

entities.name: TALESHOT
entities.gloss: A specialized spyware tool used to capture screenshots and monitor active processes and window titles.

entities.name: PIEJET
entities.gloss: A malicious Python script or tool used by threat actors for payload execution and management.

entities.name: LOADNEST
entities.gloss: A malware loader used to deliver and execute malicious components.

entities.name: HANGTHREAD
entities.gloss: A specialized tool designed to cause denial of service by exhausting computing resources and freezing the system.

entities.name: BACKSTAB
entities.gloss: A tool designed to disable or kill endpoint protection and antivirus processes.

entities.name: AUKILL
entities.gloss: A malicious tool designed to terminate security processes using legitimate vulnerable drivers.

entities.name: againandagaingmorder.ru
entities.gloss: A domain name utilized for malicious infrastructure.

entities.name: coudzoom.ru
entities.gloss: A domain name used by threat actors to host malicious tools.

entities.name: downloadrezerves.ru
entities.gloss: A domain name used to distribute malicious scripts and files.

entities.name: unayt.ru
entities.gloss: A malicious domain name hosting archives and executables.
